title: SCI-00 - The Science Argument For Triadic Structure
claim: Physics and adjacent mathematical sciences repeatedly use three-role structures in stable explanation: system/state, mediation/coupling/transformation, and record/invariant/boundary/witness. This supports a bridge claim about triadic grammar without proving the Trinity.
assumptions: A triad only counts when its three roles are functionally distinct and removing one changes the explanation.
Science-side triads are not automatically theological proof.
The document is a source map for later derivation, not the final derivation itself.
definitions: Scientific triad: three irreducible roles with functional dependence, mediation, asymmetry, and formal visibility.
Bridge candidate: cross-register structural resonance that must keep its limits visible.

bridges.from: physics structures such as decoherence, Noether symmetry, Shannon communication, open systems, and thermodynamics
bridges.to: Theophysics triadic grammar of reality, mediation, and witness
bridges.status: science-side source map; bridge declared, not proof

negative_guards: Do not say physics proves the Trinity.
Do not count arbitrary threes as evidence.
Do not map every scientific triad directly to Father/Son/Spirit.
Do not use interpretation-dependent quantum claims as settled physics.
kill_conditions: If the listed examples are only numerological and not functionally irreducible, the claim fails.
If non-triadic structures explain the same phenomena with equal or greater force, the argument must be narrowed.
If bridge language is promoted to proof language, the document must be downgraded.
